mapper.sql: select id, name, enabled, start_time, end_time, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by from seckill
mapper.select: where enabled = 1 and end_time >= now() order by (start_time <= now()) desc, start_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into seckill (name, enabled, start_time, end_time, description, created_time, updated_time, created_by, updated_by) values (#{name}, #{enabled}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{description}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.sql: select id, seckill_id, good_id, seckill_price, stock, sold, limit_per_user, description from seckill_good
mapper.select: where seckill_id = #{seckillId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_good (seckill_id, good_id, seckill_price, stock, sold, limit_per_user, description) values (#{seckillId}, #{goodId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stock}, #{sold}, #{limitPerUser}, #{description})
mapper.update: update seckill_good set stock = stock - 1, sold = sold + 1 where id = #{id} and stock > 0
update seckill_good set stock = stock + 1, sold = sold - 1 where id = #{id} and sold > 0
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_grab (seckill_no, seckill_good_id, member_id, member_account, addr_id, seckill_price, status) values (#{seckillNo}, #{seckillGoodId}, #{memberId}, #{memberAccount}, #{addrId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{status})
mapper.select: select seckill_no, seckill_good_id, member_id, member_account, addr_id, seckill_price, status, order_no from seckill_grab where seckill_no = #{seckillNo}
select seckill_no, seckill_good_id, member_id, member_account, addr_id, seckill_price, status, order_no from seckill_grab where seckill_no = #{seckillNo} for update
mapper.update: update seckill_grab set status = 'PROCESSING' where seckill_no = #{seckillNo} and status = 'PENDING'
update seckill_grab set status = 'SUCCESS', order_no = #{orderNo} where seckill_no = #{seckillNo} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update seckill_grab set status = 'FAILED' where seckill_no = #{seckillNo} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
update seckill_grab set status = 'CANCELLED' where seckill_no = #{seckillNo} and status = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.select: select seckill_no, seckill_good_id, member_id, member_account, addr_id, seckill_price, status, order_no from seckill_grab where order_no = #{orderNo} limit 1
select g.seckill_no from seckill_grab g join `order` o on o.seckill_no = g.seckill_no where g.status = 'SUCCESS' and o.status = '已取消' limit 100
select seckill_no from seckill_grab where status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') and updated_time < DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) order by updated_time asc limit 100
mapper.update: update seckill_grab set updated_time = now() where seckill_no = #{seckillNo} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
